body.p: If users cannot open XML files because Web Author cannot obtain a valid license, several issues can cause this problem.

section.title: Web Author License Server Connection Details Are not Configured Correctly
section.p: Go to the Administration Page and select License to check the License Server connection.

section.title: Web Author Cannot Connect to the License Server Over HTTP
section.p:
This problem depends on the deployment setup that you chose. There are several possible causes:
On Windows, antivirus software or a firewall blocks the connection between Web Author and the License Server. You may need to add exceptions for this connection.
Because of the server configuration, Web Author uses IPv6 to connect to the License Server. You can force IPv4 by setting these system properties:-Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true -Djava.net.preferIPv4Addresses=true
You can also set the address that the server listens on by editing the [WEB_AUTHOR_INSTALL_DIR]/tomcat/conf/server.xml file and adding the address="0.0.0.0" attribute to the <Connector> element.
The connection passes through an HTTP proxy server that blocks the connection. You can add an exception in Web Author for the License Server using the Proxy Configuration Page.
The License Server uses a self-signed HTTPS certificate (or another certificate that is not trusted by default in Java). In this case, you can go to the Administration Page and select Connection to configure Web Author to accept any HTTP certificate.

To gather more information about the problem:
Enable verbose HTTP logging in Web Author.
Check the application server access logs to see whether requests made by Web Author are received by the License Server.
Check the License Server Management and Statistics pages.

section.title: License Server Setup is Incorrect
section.p:
This might include:
The License Server is not started.
The License Server is not configured with a license.
The License Server is configured with a license for a different product.
The version of the License Server is not compatible with Web Author.
You can check most of these problems by going to the License Server's administration page.
